parameters.name: PreCheck
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform a precheck. Default value: false. If this parameter is set to true, this call only checks whether the current ASM instance meets the upgrade conditions and does not actually perform an upgrade.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh upgrade-mesh-version --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --pre-check false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh UpgradeMeshVersion --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --PreCheck false
